data.summary: Technical Business Analyst, Product Owner, and Data Engineer with 6+ years driving the discovery, documentation, and execution of business and functional requirements for global digital products. Skilled at running discovery sessions and requirement workshops, translating high-level business needs into clear specifications, and reconciling input from multiple stakeholders to align on a single direction – while also building the data pipelines and validating quality hands-on when needed. Partners closely with cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams and often serves as the sole point of contact bridging siloed engineering groups across regions. Uses data analysis to measure success and diagnose root causes of complex problems. Experienced across IoT, e-commerce, and BI platforms, and comfortable running multiple projects simultaneously across India, Korea, and US time zones.

raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES

Product & Business Analysis: Product Discovery & Requirement Definition, Business & Functional Requirements, Use Cases, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, Workflow Analysis, Roadmapping & Prioritization, Stakeholder Engagement, Solution Evaluation, UAT Coordination, Requirement Lifecycle Management, Scrum Product Ownership

Tools: Azure DevOps (ADO), JIRA, Microsoft Project (MPP) & Gantt, Advanced SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure IoT Hub, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Stream Analytics, PostgreSQL, Python / PySpark, Database Management
Domain & Technical: IoT & OTA Software Delivery, Device Twin, Cloud-to-Device Messaging, Telemetry Definition & Event Mapping, JSON Payload Design, Data
Engineering (PySpark, Spark optimization, pipeline orchestration), ETL, Lakehouse, E-commerce & Consumer Experience
Wireframing & Modelling: Axure, Balsamiq, MS Visio, Draw.io; Class, E-R, Flowchart, Activity, Data Flow, Sequence, Use Case diagrams, Wireframes, Prototypes

Testing & Quality: Manual QA Testing, Functional Testing, UAT, V&V, Defect Triage, Release Readiness, Requirement Traceability
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Visionet Systems Private Limited Technical Business Analyst (Product Owner / Data Engineer)
Web Portal Development – Remote Software Delivery Platform for Connected Devices
Acted as Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner for a global web portal enabling remote software deployment, version control, and lifecycle monitoring for
internet-connected (IoT) medical devices – driving discovery, documentation, and execution of functional and system requirements.
Authored and maintained a 200+ page requirements specification covering portal workflows, screen-level behaviour, business rules, validations, edge cases, and
acceptance criteria – abstracting high-level business needs into digestible, testable detail for engineering.
Defined requirements for core product workflows – device registration, deployment setup and approval, change-order cloning, batch selection, device eligibility and
search, and end-to-end software-deployment tracking.

Specified update-history tracking including update lifecycle, device status, version history, sourcing data from Azure IoT Hub device twins persisted into SQL for portal visibility and reporting.

Specified surfacing of device diagnostic logs from blob storage directly in the portal, enabling self-service troubleshooting for end users.

Led the web portal redesign, documenting UI behaviour, navigation flow, and screen-level changes to deliver an improved, consumer-centric user experience.

Proactively evaluated feasibility of new features and enhancements with cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams – product owners, developers, architects, ETL/BI teams, and subject-matter experts – reconciling conflicting inputs and mitigating technical risk to establish a clear technical vision.
Operated as a hybrid contributor – spanning requirements, QA validation, hands-on debugging and reverse-engineering from source code, and data validation – filling
gaps across the team to protect timelines and data integrity.

Supported rollout by coordinating review and execution of ~800 test cases within a compressed cycle; owned data validation and QA during critical resource gaps to protect integrity across environments.

Triaged complex production issues with the development team – outlining business impact and resolution options to stakeholders – and drove defect resolution, requirement clarification, UAT, and release readiness to launch a production-ready portal supporting regulatory compliance and secure global deployment.

Created and maintained Verification & Validation (V&V) documentation for the web portal, supporting multiple regulatory testing cycles and ensuring requirement traceability, test coverage, expected behaviour, and validation outcomes were properly documented.

Supported real-device testing for the web portal, validating portal functionality, workflows, and device-data behaviour using actual connected devices to ensure compliance readiness and production-level reliability.

Partnered with business teams on user manuals and training documentation so end users could efficiently adopt new features.

Built and maintained the project plan in Microsoft Project (MPP) with Gantt charts to track effort, timelines, dependencies, and milestones across workstreams – giving stakeholders clear visibility into schedule and delivery risk.
Managed all work items in Azure DevOps for transparency, audit readiness, and velocity tracking across releases while running multiple concurrent workstreams in a
matrixed, multi-time zone (India/Korea/US) environment.
Drove the web portal base-language migration from Korean to English to standardize terminology across the global application.

Coordinated requirements for updating UI labels, database values, stored procedures, and backend terminology, and identified migration-impact areas across front- end, database, and application layers.
Documented migration requirements, validation points, and expected behaviour, working with cross-functional global teams to ensure consistent English terminology.

Conceptualized and defined the approach for enabling multiple language support on the web portal following the base-language migration, outlining how the platform could support a scalable multilingual experience for global users.
IoT Telemetry Architecture, Data Engineering & Cross-Team Integration
Acted as the single liaison across four independent product-family engineering teams in Korea and the US team, becoming the go-to device subject-matter expert and
the connective tissue between groups working in silos.

Collaborated with multiple cross-functional business teams to identify, define, and document use cases, using them as the foundation for driving new product development, solution design, and delivery alignment across engineering, data, and BI teams.
Architected the telemetry data structure individually for each of four product families – studying each product's service manual and system diagram to define how data
looks in raw form and how it is transmitted, along with the event mapping.
+91 - 8208036878
2024 – Present
● Defined telemetry data models across multiple IoT product families, documenting field names, business definitions, data types, formats, sources, sample values,
validation rules, telemetry thresholds, acceptable ranges, and qualification rules to capture device performance, usage, and session details, and enable validation, anomaly detection, and reliable dashboard interpretation.

Produced telemetry event-mapping specifications translating raw device events into meaningful KPIs and dashboard insights – defining event triggers, payload fields, timestamps, device identifiers, reporting metrics, and validating transformed outputs against source values and business rules.
Designed telemetry JSON payload structures across product families and mapped attributes through ETL transformation to BI reporting metrics, supporting developers,
ETL, and BI teams with sample payload references and field-level consistency checks.
Defined the telemetry data modelling and end-to-end data architecture for raw telemetry ingestion from Azure IoT Hub, including how raw device data should be
curated, enriched, sent to Cosmos DB, and further ingested into Delta tables in Microsoft Fabric through batch ingestion.

Built the synthetic telemetry generation system as the hands-on data engineer – writing and optimizing the PySpark code and orchestration to produce realistic sample data conforming to defined business rules, unblocking BI dashboard development before live data existed.
Defined and developed the downstream fact tables and view table structures required for BI report consumption, ensuring the curated telemetry data model
supported dashboard KPIs, filters, aggregations, and performance insights.
Drove IoT BI reporting requirements – KPIs, filters, dashboard views, and validation rules – and supported preliminary Power BI dashboards on mock telemetry, using
data analysis to measure product performance and surface operational insights.
Maintained requirement traceability across business needs, user stories, development tasks, test cases, telemetry outputs, and BI reporting.
Business Intelligence & Enterprise Reporting Platform
Owned the enterprise BI and reporting platform end to end – source-side data ingestion and validation, ETL development, report development, and QA validation –
delivering 10+ dashboards for executive leadership and cross-functional teams across Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Sales, and Quality.
Gathered reporting requirements from diverse stakeholders and translated them into dashboards tracking key operational and business needs, then validated outputs
across the full BI lifecycle from requirement understanding to final delivery.

Built a Sales Opportunity dashboard tracking the complete lifecycle from opportunity creation through deal closure to revenue generation, giving leadership visibility into the sales pipeline and conversion.
Developed Global Orders and worldwide Installed Base dashboards to monitor order flow and the deployed device footprint across regions.
Delivered a dedicated Quality dashboard to track and categorize product complaints, enabling the Quality team to assess trends and prioritize business needs.

Translated complex SQL logic into executive-ready visualizations and resolved critical reporting errors, including multi-million-dollar mismatches.

Integrated post-acquisition datasets, strengthened data governance with Row-Level Security (RLS), and standardized reporting logic using reusable SQL views.
Wrote validation scripts using advanced SQL to support data validation, transformation validation, report validation, and business logic validation across the full journey
from source systems to BI reporting.

Partnered with ETL/BI teams to ensure end-to-end reporting accuracy and used Azure DevOps for documentation, QA, UAT, traceability, and post-deployment support.
Rego Digital Solutions Private Limited Business Analyst
E-Commerce Shopping Website
Developed a state-of-the-art online shopping website for seamless e-commerce transactions, providing a user-friendly interface with robust security measures, easy product navigation, search, and personalized recommendation using Agile methodology.

Interacted with stakeholders and gathered requirements using various elicitation techniques.

Created user stories with appropriate acceptance criteria with the assistance of the Product Owner. Added user stories into the product backlog using the JIRA tool.

Prioritized and validated requirements using MoSCoW and FURPS techniques, and added user stories to the sprint backlog based on prioritization order.

Collaborated with the Product Owner and Scrum Master for BV and CP, and assisted the Product Owner in the creation of the DOR and DOD checklist.
Generated Sprint and Product Burndown/Burnup charts to track project progress. Participated in product planning and UAT to successfully deliver each sprint
component.
Enhanced ED LMS Implementation

Implemented a robust LMS that enhanced education delivery, content management, and user experience for students and educators by ensuring seamless integration with existing educational systems and tools, delivering a scalable and user-friendly platform using Waterfall methodology.

Conducted Enterprise Analysis and assisted a senior BA in creating a Business Case Document, conducted Stakeholder Analysis, and prepared a RACI Matrix.
Gathered requirements from business heads using elicitation techniques and created a Business Requirements Document (BRD).

Translated BRD into Functional Requirement Document (FRD), collaborated with the technical team, and prepared SRS Document. Created and maintained RTM throughout the project.
Assisted the Testing Team by preparing test case scenarios and ensured the UAT was successful.

Created UML diagrams and wireframes to visually represent requirements using MS Visio, Balsamiq, and Axure.
IUVA Foods Private Limited Data and Operation Head
Normalized weekly unstructured CSV data into 3NF using PostgreSQL and automated multi-source integration, improving database efficiency and consistency.
Designed complex SQL queries and batch scripts for process improvements, reducing error rates and supporting strategic decisions.

Enhanced pipeline efficiency with automated SQL execution and built Power BI dashboards for timely business intelligence.

Improved onboarding completion from 35% to 60% and optimized sales tracking, driving a 20% increase in outlet sales.

Led geographic expansion to Bangalore, Mumbai, and Pune, established a vendor-management system, and supported a pre-revenue round raising Rs. 1 Crore at a Rs. 5 Crore valuation.
Documented schemas, queries, and scripts, revised business strategies, and reduced operational costs by 73%.

Authored and maintained a 200+ page requirements specification covering portal workflows, screen-level behaviour, business rules, validations, edge cases, and
acceptance criteria – abstracting high-level business needs into digestible, testable detail for engineering.
Defined requirements for core product workflows – device registration, deployment setup and approval, change-order cloning, batch selection, device eligibility and
search, and end-to-end software-deployment tracking.
Specified update-history tracking including update lifecycle, device status, version history, sourcing data from Azure IoT Hub device twins persisted into SQL for portal
visibility and reporting.
Specified surfacing of device diagnostic logs from blob storage directly in the portal, enabling self-service troubleshooting for end users.
Led the web portal redesign, documenting UI behaviour, navigation flow, and screen-level changes to deliver an improved, consumer-centric user experience.
Proactively evaluated feasibility of new features and enhancements with cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams – product owners, developers, architects, ETL/BI

Operated as a hybrid contributor – spanning requirements, QA validation, hands-on debugging and reverse-engineering from source code, and data validation – filling

Supported rollout by coordinating review and execution of ~800 test cases within a compressed cycle; owned data validation and QA during critical resource gaps to
protect integrity across environments.
Triaged complex production issues with the development team – outlining business impact and resolution options to stakeholders – and drove defect resolution,
requirement clarification, UAT, and release readiness to launch a production-ready portal supporting regulatory compliance and secure global deployment.
Created and maintained Verification & Validation (V&V) documentation for the web portal, supporting multiple regulatory testing cycles and ensuring requirement
traceability, test coverage, expected behaviour, and validation outcomes were properly documented.
Supported real-device testing for the web portal, validating portal functionality, workflows, and device-data behaviour using actual connected devices to ensure
compliance readiness and production-level reliability.
Partnered with business teams on user manuals and training documentation so end users could efficiently adopt new features.
Built and maintained the project plan in Microsoft Project (MPP) with Gantt charts to track effort, timelines, dependencies, and milestones across workstreams – giving

Managed all work items in Azure DevOps for transparency, audit readiness, and velocity tracking across releases while running multiple concurrent workstreams in a

Drove the web portal base-language migration from Korean to English to standardize terminology across the global application.
Coordinated requirements for updating UI labels, database values, stored procedures, and backend terminology, and identified migration-impact areas across front-

Documented migration requirements, validation points, and expected behaviour, working with cross-functional global teams to ensure consistent English terminology.
Conceptualized and defined the approach for enabling multiple language support on the web portal following the base-language migration, outlining how the platform
could support a scalable multilingual experience for global users.

Collaborated with multiple cross-functional business teams to identify, define, and document use cases, using them as the foundation for driving new product
development, solution design, and delivery alignment across engineering, data, and BI teams.
Architected the telemetry data structure individually for each of four product families – studying each product's service manual and system diagram to define how data
looks in raw form and how it is transmitted, along with the event mapping.
2024 – Present
Defined telemetry data models across multiple IoT product families, documenting field names, business definitions, data types, formats, sources, sample values,
validation rules, telemetry thresholds, acceptable ranges, and qualification rules to capture device performance, usage, and session details, and enable validation,
anomaly detection, and reliable dashboard interpretation.
Produced telemetry event-mapping specifications translating raw device events into meaningful KPIs and dashboard insights – defining event triggers, payload fields,
timestamps, device identifiers, reporting metrics, and validating transformed outputs against source values and business rules.
Designed telemetry JSON payload structures across product families and mapped attributes through ETL transformation to BI reporting metrics, supporting developers,
ETL, and BI teams with sample payload references and field-level consistency checks.
Defined the telemetry data modelling and end-to-end data architecture for raw telemetry ingestion from Azure IoT Hub, including how raw device data should be
curated, enriched, sent to Cosmos DB, and further ingested into Delta tables in Microsoft Fabric through batch ingestion.
Built the synthetic telemetry generation system as the hands-on data engineer – writing and optimizing the PySpark code and orchestration to produce realistic sample

Defined and developed the downstream fact tables and view table structures required for BI report consumption, ensuring the curated telemetry data model

Drove IoT BI reporting requirements – KPIs, filters, dashboard views, and validation rules – and supported preliminary Power BI dashboards on mock telemetry, using

Maintained requirement traceability across business needs, user stories, development tasks, test cases, telemetry outputs, and BI reporting.
